title: Michelle Young:
headline: Michelle, who runs a tutoring and basketball program for kids, says sneakers decide who gets to play, and that true joy is helping someone else.
story: Michelle runs Homework and Hoops at the Michelle Young Foundation: after-school tutoring plus basketball. She says sneakers are a big reason kids can't play sports, a small thing people take for granted.
Asked if she is happy, she says yes: when you step aside and help someone else, that is true joy. Giving back is the source of her happiness.
She ends on what she saw that day: kids came in with whatever sneakers they had, left running around, and she saw the confidence grow in front of her face.
do: Open on Michelle mid-thought about sneakers, hook text on screen.
Name super at 00:03: Michelle Young / Michelle Young Foundation · Homework and Hoops.
Keep the energy up. Close pauses to about 0.3 s.
End on “in front of your face”, then the end card.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No stock footage. This shoot has no B-roll.
No shoe brand names (Nikes, Puma, Jordan) in the cut or captions.

--- 030_3166.MXF ---
[00:04.5] Good, awesome. [do not use: crew talk]
[00:11.4] Perfect. [do not use: crew talk]
[00:22.5] My name is Michelle Young and I'm here with the Michelle Young Foundation.
[00:39.5] I wanted to be part of this event today because I currently run a program called Homework and Hoops where we do after-school tutoring with math and literacy but then also give the students a chance to play basketball.
[00:50.0] With Soles4Souls, they have sneakers and sneakers are a huge part of why sometimes students aren't able to partake in sports is not having the tools, not having the materials, whether it's accessibility and transportation, whether it's the sneakers that's on the bottom of their feet.
[01:08.8] It's such a huge part even though it seems like such a small thing that a lot of times people take for granted.
[01:14.7] So with this event today, being able to share the love and share the sneakers.
[01:20.3] The kids are so excited here today.
[01:22.6] It's been really awesome to watch.
[01:27.7] Yeah, I can reiterate. [do not use: restart]
[01:34.1] I wanted to be part of this event because, is that what the one you just asked or do what? [do not use: restart]
[01:40.1] Oh what am I doing here today? [do not use: restart]
[01:41.3] Okay, got it. [do not use: restart]
[01:42.2] Why I want to be part of this? [do not use: restart]
[01:43.3] Okay, why I wanted to be part of this event is it's helping the youth and being able to truly provide opportunities is incredibly impactful and that's where I love spending my energy that's where I feel most at home and so being able to watch what's taken on today to be able to provide awareness to share this amazing program and get the word out so that more and more students can be impacted by Soles4Souls and to get those sneakers out that's exactly why here today yeah moments or the moment that has stuck with me today is watching the students come in they're a little bit timid they're shy
[02:30.7] they're not really sure what's going on and they sit down in the chair and you can see them start to light up and you know they're getting their feet measured they then sit down to help get fitted for the shoes and they're picking out these sneakers and so many of them came in you know with whatever sneakers that they had and by the end they're running around with their new sneakers on whether they're lighting up, whether they're the Nikes, whether they're Puma, Jordan, whatever it is, they're just so confident and they're so happy and they're so excited.
[02:59.5] And to be able to see that change and see the confidence grow in front of your face has just been really joyful and it just reminds you to be grateful and also what we're doing here today.
--- 030_3167.MXF ---
[00:08.0] Am I happy?
[00:10.1] Yes.
[00:10.9] I look very happy, but I genuinely feel so happy after being a part of an event like this.
[00:19.0] Regardless of what's going on outside, whatever you have, whatever problems, when you truly step aside and help someone else, I think that's really true joy right there, and I'm definitely feeling that.
[00:36.5] Source my happiness.
[00:37.6] Source my happiness is definitely giving back, being able to make an impact, and looking outside of yourself, and that's exactly what we're doing.
[00:54.2] There's so many messages.
[00:56.8] One message, I think the message that has really impacted me the most is that at the times where you're struggling the most, whether you're not sure who you are, you're struggling with identity, or what you want to do, or you have just problems going on, taking a step back and being able to help someone else and get out of that mindset almost allows you to find who you are and allows you to feel good or find that path and so just remembering that the world is bigger than ourselves and a lot of times when things get complicated stepping aside and lending a helping hand whether it's big or small can
[01:39.9] really kind of help you get back on track. [do not use: the long struggling-with-identity message: the brief leaves it out]
